mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals monetary easing, which lowers discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate above 5.0% signals monetary tightening, compressing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain non-negative despite FEDFUNDS exceeding 5.0% for 10 consecutive trading days.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and falling unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals dual easing, boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: Consecutive downward trends in FEDFUNDS and UNRATE over the past 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite the interaction of FEDFUNDS and UNRATE trends.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in the unemployment rate below 4.0% during a late-cycle expansion signals peaking demand, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 4.0% from its current 4.5% level
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain non-negative despite UNRATE falling below 4.0% in a late-cycle expansion context.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDP growth (GDPC1) predicts stronger corporate earnings and investor confidence, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite sustained GDPC1 growth.

mechanism_narrative: An upward surge in the supply index (INDPRO) above 112.3 signals improved production capacity and reduced inflationary pressures, fostering positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain negative despite INDPRO exceeding 112.3.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) and the supply index (INDPRO) indicate robust economic expansion and balanced demand-supply dynamics, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases for 3 consecutive months AND INDPRO rises for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite the interaction of GDPC1 and INDPRO trends.

mechanism_narrative: Prolonged federal funds rates above 5.0% in a tightening cycle compresses equity valuations and generates negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS remains above 5.0% for 10 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain non-negative despite FEDFUNDS staying above 5.0% in a tightening cycle.
